kth-computer-science-autumn-2027.matchedTextBefore: The master's programme in Computer Science provides a broad education in computer science. Students acquire a solid foundation in advanced algorithms, computer security, artificial intelligence and internet protocols, and gain expertise through specialisation tracks. Graduates pursue careers at the forefront of software-based technologies, for example, as software engineers, game developers, or IT project managers, or pursue PhD studies for careers in research labs or academia.
